note: The owner's ask (30 Sep): measures from the financial markets. The quant block (qm_, model/blocks/quant.py) reads the yard's, rider's, yard-and-rider's, yard-at-the-course's, sire's and horse's record against the Betfair SP as a track record (the Sharpe ratio of level-stake returns at the SP, the signed chi of winners against the prices' expectation, A/E, over 90- and 365-day half-lives and the career) and the horse's form as a return series (volatility, downside deviation, best, drawdown, runs since the best, the market's volatility and trend on it). main_qm is the served main (the base, cached) plus the block; main_qm_ent carries only its record half. Every arm is also scored on the owner's staking (GBP250 to win on each horse whose expected CLV under the closing model is at least 0, 3 and 5%, walk-forward by month), now printed by scripts/clv_betfair.py beside the pre-registered rule.
